text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Speak to the Israelites and say to them: When either men or women make a special vow, the vow of a nazirite, to separate themselves to the Lord ,
text_cn: “你告诉以色列子民说：无论男女，若许了一个特愿，即‘纳齐尔’愿，献身于上主，

text_en: they shall separate themselves from wine and strong drink; they shall drink no wine vinegar or other vinegar, and shall not drink any grape juice or eat grapes, fresh or dried.
text_cn: 他该戒饮清酒和烈酒，不可喝清酒和烈酒制的醋，不可喝任何葡萄汁，也不可吃新鲜或干葡萄。

text_en: All their days as nazirites they shall eat nothing that is produced by the grapevine, not even the seeds or the skins.
text_cn: 在整个献身期内，凡葡萄树所结的，甚至葡萄仁和皮，都不可吃。

text_en: All the days of their nazirite vow no razor shall come upon the head; until the time is completed for which they separate themselves to the Lord , they shall be holy; they shall let the locks of the head grow long.
text_cn: 在他整个守献身愿的时期内，不可剃头；他几时未满献身的愿，是祝圣于上主的，应让头发自由生长。

text_en: All the days that they separate themselves to the Lord they shall not go near a corpse.
text_cn: 在他献身于上主的整个时期内，凡有死人的地方，不可走进。

text_en: Even if their father or mother, brother or sister, should die, they may not defile themselves; because their consecration to God is upon the head.
text_cn: 连父亲母亲或兄弟姊妹死时，也不可让自己沾染不洁，因为在他头上有奉献于天主的记号。

text_en: All their days as nazirites they are holy to the Lord .
text_cn: 在他整个献身期内，他是祝圣于上主的。

text_en: If someone dies very suddenly nearby, defiling the consecrated head, then they shall shave the head on the day of their cleansing; on the seventh day they shall shave it.
text_cn: 若有人忽然在他身旁猝死，那献身者的愿就沾染了不洁，在他取洁的那一天，应剃头，即在第七天他应剃头。

text_en: On the eighth day they shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest at the entrance of the tent of meeting,
text_cn: 到第八天，他应带两只斑鸠或两只雏鸽，在会幕门口交给司祭。

text_en: and the priest shall offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, and make atonement for them, because they incurred guilt by reason of the corpse. They shall sanctify the head that same day,
text_cn: 司祭取一只献作赎罪祭，另一只献作全燔祭，为他因染死尸的不洁赎罪。他在当天应祝圣自己的头，

text_en: and separate themselves to the Lord for their days as nazirites, and bring a male lamb a year old as a guilt offering. The former time shall be void, because the consecrated head was defiled.
text_cn: 重新将献身的日子奉献于上主，且应献一只一岁羔羊作赎过祭；以前的日子无效，因为献身者的头沾染了不洁。

text_en: This is the law for the nazirites when the time of their consecration has been completed: they shall be brought to the entrance of the tent of meeting,
text_cn: 关于‘纳齐尔’人的法律如下：在他献身愿期满的那一天，应引他到会幕门口，

text_en: and they shall offer their gift to the Lord , one male lamb a year old without blemish as a burnt offering, one ewe lamb a year old without blemish as a sin offering, one ram without blemish as an offering of well-being,
text_cn: 他应献给上主的祭品是：一只无残疾的一岁公羔羊作全燔祭，一只无残疾的母羔羊作赎罪祭，一只无残疾的公绵羊作和平祭，

text_en: and a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of choice flour mixed with oil and unleavened wafers spread with oil, with their grain offering and their drink offerings.
text_cn: 一篮用细面调油做的无酵饼，抹上油的无酵薄饼，以及同献的素祭及奠祭。

text_en: The priest shall present them before the Lord and offer their sin offering and burnt offering,
text_cn: 司祭在上主面前献上这些祭品后，就为他举行赎罪祭和全燔祭；

text_en: and shall offer the ram as a sacrifice of well-being to the Lord , with the basket of unleavened bread; the priest also shall make the accompanying grain offering and drink offering.
text_cn: 将公绵羊同一篮无酵饼献给上主作和平祭；然后举行素祭和奠祭。

text_en: Then the nazirites shall shave the consecrated head at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and shall take the hair from the consecrated head and put it on the fire under the sacrifice of well-being.
text_cn: 献身者在会幕门口剃去自己祝圣的头发，把祝圣的头发，放在和平祭品的火上焚烧。

text_en: The priest shall take the shoulder of the ram, when it is boiled, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them in the palms of the nazirites, after they have shaved the consecrated head.
text_cn: 他剃去祝圣的头发以后，司祭取出煮过的公绵羊肩部，与篮中的一块无酵饼和一块无酵的薄饼，放在献身者手上。

text_en: Then the priest shall elevate them as an elevation offering before the Lord ; they are a holy portion for the priest, together with the breast that is elevated and the thigh that is offered. After that the nazirites may drink wine.
text_cn: 司祭将这些祭品在上主前，行奉献的摇礼，除摇过的胸脯和举过的腿外，这些亦应是属于司祭的圣物。此后，献身者方可饮酒：

text_en: This is the law for the nazirites who take a vow. Their offering to the Lord must be in accordance with the nazirite vow, apart from what else they can afford. In accordance with whatever vow they take, so they shall do, following the law for their consecration.
text_cn: 这是关于许献身愿者的法律，献身者应奉献于上主的祭品；如果献身者照自己的财力许愿多献，就应照所许的愿，在献身愿所规定的以外，多作奉献。”

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Speak to Aaron and his sons, saying, Thus you shall bless the Israelites: You shall say to them,
text_cn: “你告诉亚郎和他的儿子说：你们应这样祝福以色列子民说：

text_en: The Lord bless you and keep you;
text_cn: ‘愿上主祝福你，保护你；

text_en: the Lord make his face to shine upon you, and be gracious to you;
text_cn: 愿上主的慈颜光照你，仁慈待你。

text_en: the Lord lift up his countenance upon you, and give you peace.
text_cn: 愿上主转面垂顾你，赐你平安。’

text_en: So they shall put my name on the Israelites, and I will bless them.
text_cn: 这样，他们将以色列子民归我名下，我必祝福他们。”
